plan: Given my value of $24, I aim to bid below this to ensure profit if I win. I will bid slightly above the midpoint of my value, at $12.5, to balance competitiveness and potential profit. This strategy maximizes long-term profit by minimizing potential losses and capitalizing on undervalued wins.

A bid above $9 risks paying more than the item is worth to me, leading to a loss. I will bid slightly below my value to potentially win if others undervalue the item, but not risk a loss. I'll bid $8.5 to balance potential gain against risk.

My value for the prize is $13. To maximize long-term profit, I should bid below my value to avoid overpaying. Given the random nature of values, I'll bid conservatively to ensure any win is profitable. I will bid $5, aiming to win if others bid low.
